verdict.rationale: Missive documents canned responses (templates) that users write once, insert with a few keystrokes, and share across a team or company. Its variables templating engine adds dynamic content such as the recipient's name, and the changelog confirms {{ user.name }}/{{ user.email }} resolution. Nothing in the evidence shows attachments being saved with or inserted from a template, and there is no independent corroboration. missing for 10: attachments in templates, hands-on/independent corroboration, detail on the variable set and insertion UX.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply

citations.quote: Instead of typing the same answer repeatedly, you write it once and insert it with a few keystrokes. In Missive, you can create a collection of canned responses and share them with a team or your entire company.
You can easily customize your responses or templates with dynamic content like your recipient's name by using our variables templating engine.
